tagline: Five miles of island oaks, three from downtown Charleston.
intro: Riverland Drive runs five miles across James Island from Wappoo Hall Road to Grimball Road, less than three miles from downtown Charleston, by tree-lined streets, wetlands and two public recreation grounds.
James Island has long been semi-rural and is now giving way to the city. The town on it was incorporated four times, Charleston having sued over the first three.

moments.title: Fort Pemberton
moments.text: In the Riverland Terrace neighborhood a Confederate earthwork fort under live oaks on the Stono River opened in July 2026 as a city park, with walking paths and a kayak launch.

moments.title: The oak canopy
moments.text: One undeveloped stretch runs under a canopy of oaks, on a road SCDOT finds remarkable for lying inside the Charleston metropolitan area at all.
